idempotent platform or local-operator checkpoint control

implementationNote: V6 remains the operator-accepted mobility baseline: one MPPI controller, one 0.48 m emergency circle and a green KeepoutFilter. Generation 9 is now installed and statically verified on the robot; it adds a full reviewed StaticLayer map to both costmaps and changes route execution from replaying every recorded polyline sample to ordered point goals: current map pose -> next checkpoint (or final endpoint) is planned by SmacPlanner2D, then followed and locally avoided by the same MPPI controller. A wall wider than MPPI's local horizon can therefore be routed around using the full map; a dynamic person or car remains a live obstacle. Planning failure holds zero and retries. Clear-route, moving-person, wide-obstacle and complete-patrol motion acceptance remain pending.
